item.title: Distributing Matrix Multiplication over a Network of CPUs
item.description:
Team Contributor, IIT Gandhinagar & University of Edinburgh, Oct 2025 – Present

This project investigates how a network of CPUs can efficiently perform matrix multiplication tasks often handled by specialized hardware like GPUs.
